title: Release-scoped capability baseline and host-scoped evidence evaluation
rationale: The 143 capability count describes the active v3.0.11 release baseline and is not a timeless architectural constant.
Canonical support, host availability, host enablement, host activity and production promotion are distinct observations.
Disabled optional components should prove non-activation rather than fabricate positive runtime evidence.
Mandatory, enabled, active or production-targeted components remain subject to positive current-host evidence and existing Acceptance/Promotion authorities.
non_goals: Do not add or remove a capability from v3.0.11.
Do not create a new runtime promotion authority.
Do not mutate current-host receipts or Evidence Registry records.
Do not treat negative assurance as positive runtime evidence.
